partition_boundary.analog: design/efuse_otp_array.sch (array, row/column drivers with level shifters, sense path incl. comparator) is the analog partition. Boundary nets it exposes: inputs row_sel[31:0], col_sel[7:0], prog_strobe, sense_en (3.3 V, from the controller) and clk (the system clock, routed to the comparator and gated there with sense_en; the clock is a digital-side net that terminates in the analog partition); output sense_out (the comparator's latched result); supplies vdd33, vprog, vss.
partition_boundary.digital: rtl/efuse_otp_ctrl.v (synchronous controller) is the digital partition. Boundary nets it drives into analog: prog_strobe, row_sel[31:0], col_sel[7:0], sense_en; it receives sense_in (= analog sense_out). clk, rst, addr[7:0], prog_en, rd_en, dout and busy are external pins of the digital partition only; clk additionally fans out to the analog comparator.
